statement: The guards are solid bands at most 4.5 mm tall, as printed
rationale: The r/diydrones review: v0.1's ducts were too tall ('no more than 4mm high') and their windows made propwash and added weight. Each guard is drawn as a 4 mm solid arc round the prop's outer half (guard_h, guard_arc_deg), spanning the prop's +-1.5 mm band; measured on the printed shape, the optimiser's rim under each band and the smoothing make it 4.15-4.9 mm (median 4.2). That extra sits below the band and outside the prop's disc, so it adds no duct; the author set the limit to 4.5 mm (2026-10-17), still well short of v0.1's 10.9 mm ducts. Nothing the optimiser draws may stand above the guards' top.

mechanism.how: the printed frame's band height at points round each guard's arc (median)
